title: Lado Okhotnikov talks about FORSAGE New Blockchain
description: Join my community! Let`s achieve our goals together with FORSAGE and learn about Network Marketing Business. Social Media: ...

asr.full_text: Friends, I have a great news for you. In the near future we are launching Forsage on a one more blockchain, Binance Smart Chain, many of you regret not doing business in Forsage from its very start, so now you have a new chance to get into starting wave on the new blockchain. Since at the moment Binance Smart Chain surpasses all other networks, including Ethereum, in activity. You can imagine what a furor in the launch of Forsage will cause. We said even before the launch on TRON, that we do not want to depend on any one blockchain, and therefore we are opening Forsage in different networks. We now have a strange situation when popularity is growing. New traffic comes to us, new people comes to us. And activity of program is falling due to difficulties on Ethereum and Ontron. The fees on Ethereum are too huge. Ontron transactions are difficult and fees have also increased. People come to Forsage, but cannot complete transactions. There are many other interesting blockchains, but the rest have either low popularity or the development is still crude and not ready to accept Forsage. And Binance Smart Chain is number 1 in popularity. There are low commissions, high bandwidth. Binance has an impeccable reputation, one of the most anywhere. I'm sure that a solution will be found on Ethereum. Bucks will be fixed on Tron. But we don't know when this will happen. It is not depend on us. Business should not stand still. Business is people. We must have activity here and now. Even if one of you decides that, you know, I already have slots in Ethereum and Tron I will not be involved on Binance. Even with such a position, launching Forsage on the Binance is a positive for you. Because when there will be a decision and we can actively develop Ethereum and Tron again, then everybody will be better if at the same time Forsage keeps active. You don't want the participants to cool out to Forsage, right? Moreover now new people will come to us who have not been on Ethereum and Tron before, but they will want to connect. We will always encourage participants to go to all the blockchains that Forsage runs on. And all leaders will spread this idea. And this is logical. After all, you understand that people in your structure will not want to miss payments, and therefore they will go to all four such platform. You need to be there before your teams. This understanding is conveyed to everyone. So, many will do so. The most prestigious will not wait and will start their teams on Ethereum and on Tron in advance. Therefore, I say this is good news for all of you. And even more so for those who expected something new from us. Do you understand how grandiose this event is? Binance Smart Chain gives us the opportunity to fully deploy in a way that we could not before. Therefore, this launch will be much more powerful than on Ethereum. When we started, in last year, we did not have such resources and developments as now. Therefore, Forsage will now reach a whole new level, and his is a great chance to each of you! Plus there is another surprise for you in marketing. We have developed and added one more program. As you know, EX3 and X4 are fast programs. EX Gold is a larger and more long-term one. Many people have asked us to make an intermediate version, and we will implement it in Binance. In total, we have 4 programs on 3 SCs. At first we will release a contract with X3 and X4 at that time tests of the smart contract with the new program will still be under way. After which we will release it. Then after a while it will be the XGold turn. The coin in which all transactions will take place is Binance Coin, BNB, one of the top cryptocurrencies with a very strong foundation and therefore stable and promising. An interesting coincidence that the BNB price is now about the same level as Ether Ethereum was when we launched Forsage a year ago. Many participants earned tens of thousands and hundreds of thousands of dollars and some even became dollar millionaires in Forsage. Now on Binance Smart Chain, we will not only repeat success, we will move much farther forward. repeat success we will move much farther forward by the way the slots in x3 and x4 are the same in numbers as on aetherium there are also 12 slots in total also the general entrance for registration equal 0.05 on the not aetherium but BNB it is at the current exchange rate is only about $11 or $12. That is, the first slot of each program costs $0.025 and also each next slot is exactly two times more expensive than the previous one. Everything looks like Ethereum on the start of Forsage Only commissions are small, and there are much more opportunities. We will cover marketing in more details in the coming video. In my next video, I recommend to prepare your teams and also prepare wallets. Some wallets that we used for ETH are also suitable. For example, Metamask for computer or Trust wallet for smartphones only in the wallet you need to switch the Binance Smart Chain Network it's easy to do prepare the required amount of BNP they are easy to buy on the Binance exchange or through P2P exchanges or DeFi exchanges we will post all the necessary instructions shortly friends Friends, do not miss this moment – a powerful furor is about to begin in Forsage.

textual.observation: The speaker promotes joining Forsage on Binance Smart Chain and links participation with a chance to earn very large dollar amounts, including millionaire outcomes.

evidence.quote: you have a new chance to get into starting wave on the new blockchain
Many participants earned tens of thousands and hundreds of thousands of dollars and some even became dollar millionaires in Forsage.

textual.context: Promotional and invitational framing by the speaker; the earnings statement is presented as a claim about past participants and is not independently corroborated.
textual.potential_relevance: A large-return claim is linked to the requested action of entering Forsage during the new-chain launch.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether these earnings occurred, how many participants achieved them, or the likelihood and conditions of such outcomes.

textual.observation: The speaker asks viewers to use multiple Forsage blockchains and position teams ahead of others to avoid missing payments.

evidence.quote: people in your structure will not want to miss payments, and therefore they will go to all four such platform
You need to be there before your teams.

textual.context: Promotional network-marketing framing; payments and team structure are asserted in the speech, with no transaction records.
textual.potential_relevance: A payment-related benefit is tied to multi-platform participation and team positioning.
textual.limitations: The records do not specify the payment mechanism, payout terms, or whether viewers are required to recruit others.

textual.observation: The speaker describes paid Forsage registration and slot purchases in BNB, with later slots priced at twice the prior slot.

evidence.quote: the general entrance for registration equal 0.05 on the not aetherium but BNB it is at the current exchange rate is only about $11 or $12.
the first slot of each program costs $0.025 and also each next slot is exactly two times more expensive than the previous one.

textual.context: Promotional participation explanation; the ASR contains apparent transcription errors around the blockchain and currency wording.
textual.potential_relevance: A concrete payment structure is directly linked to registering for and progressing within the promoted program.
textual.limitations: The records do not confirm the exact fee amounts, exchange rate, contract terms, or whether fees are refundable.

textual.observation: The speaker instructs viewers to prepare wallets and acquire BNB through Binance, P2P, or DeFi exchanges for the launch.

evidence.quote: prepare wallets.
prepare the required amount of BNP
they are easy to buy on the Binance exchange or through P2P exchanges or DeFi exchanges

textual.context: Instructional and promotional context; the source does not show an actual transaction or wallet address.
textual.potential_relevance: Wallet setup and asset acquisition are concrete requested actions connected to participating in the promoted launch.
textual.limitations: No wallet address, authorization request, transfer confirmation, or outcome is provided.

textual.observation: The message uses time-sensitive language encouraging immediate activity and preparation before the new launch.

evidence.quote: We must have activity here and now.
do not miss this moment – a powerful furor is about to begin in Forsage.

textual.context: Promotional urgency; no specific deadline or finite availability is stated.
textual.potential_relevance: Urgency is linked to joining and preparing teams and wallets for the launch.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish a real deadline, scarcity, or consequence for waiting.

textual.observation: The speaker presents Binance Smart Chain and BNB as highly popular, low-commission, stable, and promising in support of the promoted participation.

evidence.quote: Binance Smart Chain is number 1 in popularity. There are low commissions, high bandwidth.
one of the top cryptocurrencies with a very strong foundation and therefore stable and promising.

textual.context: Positive endorsement by the speaker; these characterizations are not independently verified in the source records.
textual.potential_relevance: Platform and asset-quality claims are used to support the requested action of joining Forsage on Binance Smart Chain and using BNB.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish the stated ranking, technical performance, stability, or other underlying facts.

textual_context_notes.observation: The speaker acknowledges that Ethereum and Tron have transaction difficulties and says the timing of a fix is unknown.

evidence.quote: But we don't know when this will happen. It is not depend on us.

textual_context_notes.observation: The description explicitly frames the offer as community participation and network marketing.

evidence.quote: Join my community! Let`s achieve our goals together with FORSAGE and learn about Network Marketing Business.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it actively promotes joining Forsage through paid slots and coordinated teams, presenting a new blockchain launch as a chance to enter early and benefit from participant activity. The speaker highlights claims that participants earned tens or hundreds of thousands of dollars or became millionaires, urges viewers to prepare teams and wallets, and creates urgency by saying not to miss the upcoming launch. This is a recruitment-dependent earning solicitation rather than neutral reporting or an ordinary wallet tutorial.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the promoted opportunity uses slots, participant structures, teams, and payments across programs, with expected benefits tied to recruiting and activating people in those structures. The video explicitly says participants will encourage others to join multiple blockchains and that people should be present before their teams.

evidence.quote: people in your structure will not want to miss payments, and therefore they will go to all four such platform. You need to be there before your teams.

evidence.quote: Many participants earned tens of thousands and hundreds of thousands of dollars and some even became dollar millionaires in Forsage.

evidence.quote: prepare wallets

evidence.observation: The promoted program requires purchasing progressively more expensive slots.
evidence.quote: the first slot of each program costs $0.025 and also each next slot is exactly two times more expensive than the previous one.

evidence.observation: The closing language adds urgency and encourages viewers not to miss the promoted launch.
